messages:
maria: heads-up — canary in usw2 shows a steady p95 bump (~+40ms) after the v4.1.0 rollout. hosted looks fine; dedicated pools are the ones regressing. auto-rollback is disabled for dedicated. thoughts on manual vs letting bot handle?

deploy-bot: alert summary: p95_delta=+40ms, error_rate=1.4% (baseline 0.6%), window=6m. note: auto-rollback suppressed for dedicated cohorts. recommendation: manual targeted rollback for dedicated -> v4.0.8. sample: `/deploy rollback --to v4.0.8 --cohort=dedicated --regions=usw2 --slice=25% --pin=10m`
josh: +1 for manual. we should avoid a full-hosted revert. propose staged slices (25% -> 50% -> 100%) with 90s smoke checks. also: change window ends in 50m; prefer to finish before then.
eva: i'll draft release note and customer ping. also suggest we include `--warm-kv` so post-rollback latencies don't spike from cold cache. will add a telemetry tag rollback_reason=canary-p95 to the deploy command.
maria: ok @deploy-bot start 25% slice with preserve-sessions and warm-kv=4m. include tag.
deploy-bot: running: ```
/deploy rollback --to v4.0.8 --cohort=dedicated --regions=usw2 --slice=25% --pin=10m --preserve-sessions=true --warm-kv=4m --tag=rollback_reason:canary-p95
```
Estimated 70s. Reporting back with health.
deploy-bot: 25% slice complete. p95 back near baseline, error_rate stable. awaiting manual confirmation to continue to 50%.
josh: proceed to 50% — go slow.
deploy-bot: increasing slice to 50% (graceful drain 45s).
deploy-bot: 50% done. health good. proceeding to 100% on confirmation.
maria: go to 100%.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic pinned to v4.0.8 for 10m. KV warm period active. health checks: p95 baseline restored, error_rate 0.7%. ops-bot: created ticket INF-3982 for RCA and linked telemetry.
eva: posted customer note to #release-comms and DM'ed account owners. release-note blurb: "Targeted rollback to v4.0.8 for Dedicated pools due to p95 regression observed in canary; Hosted remains on v4.1.0. Monitoring indicates restoration of baseline metrics."
josh: follow-ups: add a pre-canary embedding of the eval suite for p95 checks and add a dedicated-auto-rollback flag to avoid manual steps next time. I'll file follow-up PRs.
maria: thanks team. closing coordination here. please update INF-3982 with timeline and owners. :white_check_mark:
